subject: bella-vargas
label: She picked it herself
from: 36–26–46 — and a v8 proposal of 40–28–42 offered to fix it
to: TWENTY-EIGHT-INCH WAIST, FORTY-SIX-INCH HIPS — authored, chosen, and hers
note:
NOT A RECONCILIATION. NOT A PROPOSAL. A WOMAN AT A CONSENT MENU, choosing.

BELLA WANTED THE MEWTWO BUILD HOURGLASS and she went and got it. 28 over 46 is a ratio of 0.609 — EXTREME HOURGLASS, the deepest band on the v8 scale, and she did not arrive there by anybody's arithmetic. She sat down at Hathaway Clinic, read the Immutable Core, worked the Menu, reviewed the whole body Nereid showed her, and gave FINAL AUTHORIZATION on a figure that is the widest hip-to-waist drop in the canon.

WHICH RESOLVES THE THREE-FIGURE PROBLEM THE ARCHIVE OPENED THIS MORNING. The clinic passage was not splitting the difference between two records; it was the only one of the three that was ever describing a real choice. THE PROPOSAL WAS THE ONE THAT NEEDED FIXING, and the woman had already fixed it.

AND THE HOUSE IS SHAPED LIKE THIS. 0.609 is what the Cheeks are a portrait of.

ONE NUMBER IS STILL MISSING: her bust. The old 36 fails the v8 bust gate against 46-inch hips, which needs 44 or better. The Archive is not inventing it.
